On this page

Model syntax ​

Build a regression with several predictors, shared group effects and reusable components from one @brm declaration. The examples use named tuples; a data frame works too. Columns may have different lengths when they describe different observation or group axes.

Formulas and links ​

This model predicts both the mean and the standard deviation. The subject's intercept and slope are correlated, and the scale stays positive through its explicit log link.

using BayesianRegressionModels

builder = @brm begin
    mu ~ 1 + x + (1 + x | person | subject)
    log(sigma) ~ 1 + x
    y ~ Normal(mu, sigma)

    effect(mu, :) ~ Normal(0, 1)
    effect(sigma, Intercept) ~ Normal(-1, 0.5)
    effect(sigma, x) ~ Normal(0, 0.2)
    sd(:, person) ~ Exponential(0.5)
    cor(:, person) ~ LKJCholesky(2, 2)
end
data = (; subject=["a", "a", "b", "b", "c", "c"],
          x=[-1., 1., -1., 1., -1., 1.],
          y=[-0.6, 0.9, -0.2, 1.4, -0.8, 0.5])
model = builder(data)

julia
"""
Group-level (varying) effects of grouping `g`, `K` correlated margins per level.

Non-centered, from the scales `tau[1:K]` (drawn from their priors), the Cholesky factor of the margins' correlation `L ~ LKJCholesky(K, eta)` and standardized effects
`z[1:length(levels(g)), 1:K] ~ Normal(0, 1)`. Returns the
level-by-margin matrix `z * transpose(tau .* L)`, one row per level of `g` in order.
"""
brm_correlated_group_effects(g, K, eta) = begin
        tau[1:K] .~ Exponential.(0.5)
        L ~ LKJCholesky(K, eta)
        z[1:length(levels(g)), 1:K] .~ Normal.(0, 1)
        return z * transpose(tau .* L)
    end

"""
Population-level effects: one coefficient per column of the design matrix `X`.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns the linear predictor
`X * beta_pop`. `ncoef` is the number of columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per coefficient.
"""
brm_population_effects(X, ncoef, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

begin
    subject_fit_levels = brm_fit_levels(subject_fit)
    b_person_subject ~ brm_correlated_group_effects(subject_fit_levels, 2, bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta)
    subject_level = brm_level_indices(subject, subject_fit_levels)
    ranef_mu_person_subject = b_person_subject[subject_level, 1] .+ b_person_subject[subject_level, 2] .* x
    X_mu = hcat(ones(length(subject)), x)
    pop_mu ~ brm_population_effects(X_mu, 2, 0.0, 1.0)
    mu = pop_mu .+ ranef_mu_person_subject
    X_log_sigma = hcat(ones(length(x)), x)
    pop_log_sigma ~ brm_population_effects(X_log_sigma, 2, [-1.0, 0.0], [0.5, 0.2])
    log_sigma = pop_log_sigma
    sigma = exp.(log_sigma)
    y .~ Normal.(mu, exp.(log_sigma))
end

functions {
matrix hcat(
    vector x,
    vector y
) {
    int n = dims(x)[1];
    if (dims(y)[1] != n) reject("hcat: dim mismatch — `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `x` dim 1. `n` sizes: `x` dim 1 (= ", dims(x)[1], "), `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ").");
    return append_col(x, y);
}
vector normal_lpdfs(
    vector obs,
    vector loc,
    vector scale
) {
    return jbroadcasted_normal_lpdfs(obs, loc, scale);
}
vector jbroadcasted_normal_lpdfs(
    vector x1,
    vector x2,
    vector x3
) {
    int n = dims(x1)[1];
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = normal_lpdfs(broadcasted_getindex(x1, i), broadcasted_getindex(x2, i), broadcasted_getindex(x3, i));
    }
    return rv;
}
real normal_lpdfs(
    real args1,
    real args2,
    real args3
) {
    return normal_lpdf(args1 | args2, args3);
}
real broadcasted_getindex(vector x, int i) {
    return x[i];
}
vector normal_vector_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    vector a,
    vector b
) {
    int n = anontok__1;
    if((n == 0)) {
        vector[n] rv;
        return rv;
    } else {
        return to_vector(normal_rng(a, b));
    }
}
}

    matrix[n_subject, n_terms_person_subject] b_person_subject = ((diag_pre_multiply(b_person_subject_tau, b_person_subject_L) * b_person_subject_z)');
    vector[x_n] pop_mu = (X_mu * pop_mu_beta_pop);

import numpy as np
import scipy.special as ssp
from typing import Any

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import jax.scipy.linalg
import jax.scipy.special as jsp
from jax.typing import ArrayLike

jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)

DATA = {"X_log_sigma": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 2, "ragged": False}, "bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "subject": {"dtype": "object", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "subject_fit": {"dtype": "object", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "y": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}}
INPUTS = ("unconstrained", "ppl_last_b_person_subject_z", "ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z", "ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop", "ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop", "ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop", "ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop", "subject_level", "x", "X_mu", "X_log_sigma", "y", "bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta", "ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer")
PREPARED = {"ppl_last_b_person_subject_z": {"dtype": "int64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z": {"dtype": "int64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop": {"dtype": "int64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop": {"dtype": "int64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop": {"dtype": "int64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop": {"dtype": "int64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "subject_level": {"dtype": "int64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "X_mu": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 2, "ragged": False}, "X_log_sigma": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 2, "ragged": False}, "y": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}, "ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 0, "ragged": False}}
UNTRANSLATED = {}


def _rk_order_key_np(x):
    # Julia's isless order of an array as sortable keys: a float is an integer
    # key, -0.0 before 0.0 and every NaN last, equal for values isequal treats
    # as equal. Integer and string arrays are their own keys.
    x = np.asarray(x)
    if x.dtype.kind != "f":
        return x
    bits = np.where(np.isnan(x), np.nan, x).astype(np.float64).view(np.int64)
    return np.where(bits < 0, bits ^ np.int64(0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF), bits)


def _rk_unique_np(x):
    # Julia's unique of a vector: the first value of each isequal class, in
    # order.
    x = np.asarray(x)
    _, first = np.unique(_rk_order_key_np(x), return_index=True)
    return x[np.sort(first)]


def _rk_sort_np(x):
    # Julia's sort of a vector: ascending in isless order, equal values in
    # their order.
    x = np.asarray(x)
    return x[np.argsort(_rk_order_key_np(x), kind="stable")]


def _brm_sorted_labels_np(source):
    labels = _rk_unique_np(source)
    sorted_ = _rk_sort_np(labels)
    return sorted_


def _brm_fit_levels_np(source):
    value = _brm_sorted_labels_np(source)
    levels = value
    return levels


def _brm_level_indices_np(labels, source):
    value = _brm_fit_levels_np(source)
    levels = value
    lookup = {}
    for k in range(1, len(levels) + 1):
        lookup[levels[k - 1]] = k
    indices = np.zeros((len(labels),), dtype=np.int64)
    for r in range(1, len(labels) + 1):
        position = lookup.get(labels[r - 1], 0)
        if position == 0:
            raise ValueError("".join([str("RK backend: group label `"), str(labels[r - 1]), str("` is not one of the "), str(len(levels)), str(" fitted levels. A replay keeps the fitted levels of every grouping it does not resample; name the grouping in `resample_groups` to take the new data's own levels.")]))
        indices[r - 1] = position
    return indices


def _rk_levels_np(x):
    arr = np.asarray(x)
    values = sorted(set(v for v in arr.tolist() if v is not None))
    return np.array(values, dtype=object if arr.dtype == object else arr.dtype)


class StaticInt(int):
    """An integer of the prepared data that sets a shape.

    It is an `int` everywhere, and `jax.jit` treats it as static, so the
    functions jit with the prepared data as arguments; a new value traces
    them again.
    """

    def __repr__(self):
        return "StaticInt(%d)" % int(self)


jax.tree_util.register_pytree_node(StaticInt, lambda s: ((), int(s)), lambda v, _: StaticInt(v))


def prepare_data(X_log_sigma: ArrayLike, bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta: ArrayLike, subject: Any, subject_fit: Any, x: ArrayLike, y: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The functions' data inputs, computed from the raw data once per dataset.

    Pass the data by the names the model reads them; a list of arrays is a ragged
    column. Call the other functions with the result: `f(u, **prepared)`.
    """
    X_log_sigma = np.asarray(X_log_sigma, dtype=np.float64)
    subject = np.asarray(subject, dtype=object)
    subject_fit = np.asarray(subject_fit, dtype=object)
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
    X_mu = np.asarray(np.concatenate([np.ones((len(subject),), dtype=np.float64)[:, None], x[:, None]], axis=1), dtype=np.float64)
    rkppl_value_bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta = bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta
    value = _brm_fit_levels_np(subject_fit)
    subject_fit_levels = value
    value_2 = _brm_level_indices_np(subject, subject_fit_levels)
    subject_level = np.asarray(value_2, dtype=np.int64)
    ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z = len(_rk_levels_np(subject_fit_levels))
    ppl_last_b_person_subject_z = 3 + 2 * ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z
    ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop = ppl_last_b_person_subject_z + 1
    ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop = ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop + 1
    ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop + 1
    ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop + 1
    if np.isfinite(bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta) and bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta > 0:
        value_4 = ssp.gammaln(bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta + 0.5)
        total = 1 * value_4
        for k in range(1, 2):
            value_5 = ssp.gammaln(bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta + 0.5 * (1 - k))
            total = total - 0.5 * k * 1.1447298858494002 - value_5
        value_3 = total
    else:
        value_3 = -np.inf
    ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer = value_3
    return {"ppl_last_b_person_subject_z": StaticInt(ppl_last_b_person_subject_z), "ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z": StaticInt(ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z), "ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop": StaticInt(ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop), "ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop": StaticInt(ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop), "ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop": StaticInt(ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop), "ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop": StaticInt(ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop), "subject_level": np.asarray(subject_level, dtype=np.int64), "x": np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64), "X_mu": np.asarray(X_mu, dtype=np.float64), "X_log_sigma": np.asarray(X_log_sigma, dtype=np.float64), "y": np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64), "bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta": bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta, "ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer": ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer}


def log_density(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log density a sampler targets at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`.

    The sum of `log_prior`, `log_likelihood` and `log_jacobian`.
    """
    ppl_last_b_person_subject_z = prepared["ppl_last_b_person_subject_z"]
    ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z = prepared["ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z"]
    ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop"]
    ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop"]
    ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop"]
    ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop"]
    subject_level = prepared["subject_level"]
    x = prepared["x"]
    X_mu = prepared["X_mu"]
    X_log_sigma = prepared["X_log_sigma"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta = prepared["bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta"]
    ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer = prepared["ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    subject_level = jnp.asarray(subject_level)
    x = jnp.asarray(x)
    X_mu = jnp.asarray(X_mu)
    X_log_sigma = jnp.asarray(X_log_sigma)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    ppl_parg_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop_1 = jnp.asarray([-1.0, 0.0], dtype=jnp.float64)
    ppl_parg_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop_2 = jnp.asarray([0.5, 0.2], dtype=jnp.float64)
    plate_argument = unconstrained[0:2]
    def cell(ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau):
        constrain = jnp.exp(ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau)
        return constrain
    b_person_subject_tau = (jnp.zeros(plate_argument.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in plate_argument.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(0,))(plate_argument))
    plate_argument_2 = unconstrained[0:2]
    def cell_2(ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau):
        return ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau
    ppl_ljcells_b_person_subject_tau = (jnp.zeros(plate_argument_2.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in plate_argument_2.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_2, in_axes=(0,))(plate_argument_2))
    ppl_lkj_raw_b_person_subject_L = unconstrained[2:3]
    ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L = jnp.tanh(ppl_lkj_raw_b_person_subject_L)
    out = jnp.ones((2,), dtype=jnp.float64)
    tuple_ = (1, 2, 1.0)
    i = tuple_[0]
    j = tuple_[1]
    d = tuple_[2]
    def loop_body(p, carry):
        (d_2, i_2, j_2, out_2) = carry
        d_3 = d_2 * jnp.sqrt(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            i_3 = i_2 + 1
            return (None, jnp.asarray(d_3, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i_3, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_2, dtype=jnp.int64), out_2)
        def else_arm():
            out_3 = out_2.at[j_2 - 1].set(d_3)
            tuple__2 = (1, j_2 + 1, 1.0)
            i_4 = tuple__2[0]
            j_3 = tuple__2[1]
            d_4 = tuple__2[2]
            return (None, jnp.asarray(d_4, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i_4, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_3, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3)
        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_2 + 1 < j_2, then_arm, else_arm)
        return (branch[1], branch[2], branch[3], branch[4])
    loop_carry = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body, (jnp.asarray(d, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j, dtype=jnp.int64), out))
    let_value = loop_carry[3]
    ppl_lkj_diagonal_b_person_subject_L = let_value
    out_2 = jnp.zeros((2, 2), dtype=jnp.float64)
    out_3 = out_2.at[0, 0].set(1.0)
    tuple__2 = (1, 2, 1.0)
    i_2 = tuple__2[0]
    j_2 = tuple__2[1]
    w = tuple__2[2]
    def loop_body_2(p_2, carry_2):
        (i_3, j_3, out_4, w_2) = carry_2
        out_5 = out_4.at[j_3 - 1, i_3 - 1].set(ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p_2 - 1] * w_2)
        w_3 = w_2 * jnp.sqrt(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p_2 - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            i_4 = i_3 + 1
            return (None, jnp.asarray(i_4, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_3, dtype=jnp.int64), out_5, jnp.asarray(w_3, dtype=jnp.float64))
        def else_arm():
            out_6 = out_5.at[j_3 - 1, j_3 - 1].set(ppl_lkj_diagonal_b_person_subject_L[j_3 - 1])
            tuple__3 = (1, j_3 + 1, 1.0)
            i_5 = tuple__3[0]
            j_4 = tuple__3[1]
            w_4 = tuple__3[2]
            return (None, jnp.asarray(i_5, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_4, dtype=jnp.int64), out_6, jnp.asarray(w_4, dtype=jnp.float64))
        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_3 + 1 < j_3, then_arm, else_arm)
        return (branch[1], branch[2], branch[3], branch[4])
    loop_carry_2 = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body_2, (jnp.asarray(i_2, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_2, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3, jnp.asarray(w, dtype=jnp.float64)))
    value = loop_carry_2[2]
    b_person_subject_L = value
    total = 0.0
    tuple__3 = (1, 2)
    i_3 = tuple__3[0]
    j_3 = tuple__3[1]
    def loop_body_3(p_3, carry_3):
        (i_4, j_4, total_2) = carry_3
        total_3 = total_2 + (j_4 - i_4 + 1) / 2 * jnp.log(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p_3 - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():

    let_value_2 = loop_carry_3[2]
    ppl_lkj_logjac_b_person_subject_L = let_value_2
    ppl_arrflat_b_person_subject_z = unconstrained[3:ppl_last_b_person_subject_z]
    b_person_subject_z = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_b_person_subject_z, (ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z, 2), order="F")
    pop_mu_beta_pop = unconstrained[ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop - 1:ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop]
    pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = unconstrained[ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop - 1:ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop]
    b_person_subject = b_person_subject_z @ jnp.transpose(b_person_subject_tau[..., None] * b_person_subject_L)
    ranef_mu_person_subject = b_person_subject[subject_level - 1, 0] + b_person_subject[subject_level - 1, 1] * x
    pop_mu = X_mu @ pop_mu_beta_pop
    pop_log_sigma = X_log_sigma @ pop_log_sigma_beta_pop
    rkppl_synth_1 = jnp.exp(pop_log_sigma)
    ppl_offset_mu = pop_mu + ranef_mu_person_subject
    def cell_3(y_2, mu, rkppl_synth_1_2):
        def then_arm():
            log_scale = jnp.log(rkppl_synth_1_2)
            def then_arm_2():
                return 1.0
            def else_arm():
                return rkppl_synth_1_2
            value_2 = (y_2 - mu) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_synth_1_2 == 0, y_2 == mu), then_arm_2, else_arm)
            standardized = value_2
            value_3 = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            standard_logpdf = value_3
            def then_arm_3():
                return 0.0
            def else_arm_2():
                return log_scale
            value_4 = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_synth_1_2 == 0, y_2 != mu), then_arm_3, else_arm_2)

    def cell_4(b_person_subject_tau_2):

        scale_binding = 1.0
        log_scale = np.log(scale_binding)
        def then_arm_2():
            return pop_mu_beta_pop_2 == location_binding
        def else_arm_2():
            return False
        value_2 = (then_arm_2() if scale_binding == 0 else else_arm_2())

            return scale_binding
        standardized = (pop_mu_beta_pop_2 - location_binding) / jax.lax.cond(value_2, then_arm_3, else_arm_3)

    ppl_pw_prior_pop_mu_beta_pop = (jnp.zeros(pop_mu_beta_pop.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in pop_mu_beta_pop.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_6, in_axes=(0,))(pop_mu_beta_pop))

            return 1.0
        def else_arm_2():
            return scale

    ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer = prepared["ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    subject_level = jnp.asarray(subject_level)
    x = jnp.asarray(x)
    X_mu = jnp.asarray(X_mu)
    X_log_sigma = jnp.asarray(X_log_sigma)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    plate_argument = unconstrained[0:2]
    def cell(ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau):
        constrain = jnp.exp(ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau)
        return constrain
    b_person_subject_tau = (jnp.zeros(plate_argument.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in plate_argument.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(0,))(plate_argument))
    ppl_lkj_raw_b_person_subject_L = unconstrained[2:3]
    ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L = jnp.tanh(ppl_lkj_raw_b_person_subject_L)
    out = jnp.ones((2,), dtype=jnp.float64)
    tuple_ = (1, 2, 1.0)
    i = tuple_[0]
    j = tuple_[1]
    d = tuple_[2]
    def loop_body(p, carry):
        (d_2, i_2, j_2, out_2) = carry
        d_3 = d_2 * jnp.sqrt(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            i_3 = i_2 + 1
            return (None, jnp.asarray(d_3, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i_3, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_2, dtype=jnp.int64), out_2)
        def else_arm():
            out_3 = out_2.at[j_2 - 1].set(d_3)
            tuple__2 = (1, j_2 + 1, 1.0)
            i_4 = tuple__2[0]
            j_3 = tuple__2[1]
            d_4 = tuple__2[2]
            return (None, jnp.asarray(d_4, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i_4, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_3, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3)
        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_2 + 1 < j_2, then_arm, else_arm)
        return (branch[1], branch[2], branch[3], branch[4])
    loop_carry = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body, (jnp.asarray(d, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j, dtype=jnp.int64), out))
    let_value = loop_carry[3]
    ppl_lkj_diagonal_b_person_subject_L = let_value
    out_2 = jnp.zeros((2, 2), dtype=jnp.float64)
    out_3 = out_2.at[0, 0].set(1.0)
    tuple__2 = (1, 2, 1.0)
    i_2 = tuple__2[0]
    j_2 = tuple__2[1]
    w = tuple__2[2]
    def loop_body_2(p_2, carry_2):
        (i_3, j_3, out_4, w_2) = carry_2
        out_5 = out_4.at[j_3 - 1, i_3 - 1].set(ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p_2 - 1] * w_2)
        w_3 = w_2 * jnp.sqrt(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p_2 - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            i_4 = i_3 + 1
            return (None, jnp.asarray(i_4, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_3, dtype=jnp.int64), out_5, jnp.asarray(w_3, dtype=jnp.float64))
        def else_arm():
            out_6 = out_5.at[j_3 - 1, j_3 - 1].set(ppl_lkj_diagonal_b_person_subject_L[j_3 - 1])
            tuple__3 = (1, j_3 + 1, 1.0)
            i_5 = tuple__3[0]
            j_4 = tuple__3[1]
            w_4 = tuple__3[2]
            return (None, jnp.asarray(i_5, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_4, dtype=jnp.int64), out_6, jnp.asarray(w_4, dtype=jnp.float64))
        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_3 + 1 < j_3, then_arm, else_arm)
        return (branch[1], branch[2], branch[3], branch[4])
    loop_carry_2 = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body_2, (jnp.asarray(i_2, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_2, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3, jnp.asarray(w, dtype=jnp.float64)))
    value = loop_carry_2[2]
    b_person_subject_L = value
    ppl_arrflat_b_person_subject_z = unconstrained[3:ppl_last_b_person_subject_z]
    b_person_subject_z = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_b_person_subject_z, (ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z, 2), order="F")
    pop_mu_beta_pop = unconstrained[ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop - 1:ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop]
    pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = unconstrained[ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop - 1:ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop]
    b_person_subject = b_person_subject_z @ jnp.transpose(b_person_subject_tau[..., None] * b_person_subject_L)
    ranef_mu_person_subject = b_person_subject[subject_level - 1, 0] + b_person_subject[subject_level - 1, 1] * x
    pop_mu = X_mu @ pop_mu_beta_pop
    pop_log_sigma = X_log_sigma @ pop_log_sigma_beta_pop
    rkppl_synth_1 = jnp.exp(pop_log_sigma)
    ppl_offset_mu = pop_mu + ranef_mu_person_subject
    def cell_2(y_2, mu, rkppl_synth_1_2):
        def then_arm():
            log_scale = jnp.log(rkppl_synth_1_2)
            def then_arm_2():
                return 1.0
            def else_arm():
                return rkppl_synth_1_2
            value_2 = (y_2 - mu) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_synth_1_2 == 0, y_2 == mu), then_arm_2, else_arm)
            standardized = value_2
            value_3 = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            standard_logpdf = value_3
            def then_arm_3():
                return 0.0
            def else_arm_2():
                return log_scale
            value_4 = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_synth_1_2 == 0, y_2 != mu), then_arm_3, else_arm_2)
            return value_4
        def else_arm_3():
            return -jnp.inf
        ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(rkppl_synth_1_2 > 0, then_arm, else_arm_3)
        return ppl_density
    ppl_pw_y_resp = (jnp.zeros(y.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in y.shape[:1] and ppl_offset_mu.shape[:1] == y.shape[:1] and rkppl_synth_1.shape[:1] == y.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_2, in_axes=(0, 0, 0))(y, ppl_offset_mu, rkppl_synth_1))
    ppl_lik_y_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_y_resp)
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value_2 = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop else else_arm())
    return ppl_lik_y_resp


def log_jacobian(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log Jacobian of the constraining transforms at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    ppl_last_b_person_subject_z = prepared["ppl_last_b_person_subject_z"]
    ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z = prepared["ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z"]
    ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop"]
    ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop"]
    ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop"]
    ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop = prepared["ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop"]
    subject_level = prepared["subject_level"]
    x = prepared["x"]
    X_mu = prepared["X_mu"]
    X_log_sigma = prepared["X_log_sigma"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta = prepared["bucket_person_subject_lkj_eta"]
    ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer = prepared["ppl_prior_b_person_subject_L_normalizer"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    subject_level = jnp.asarray(subject_level)
    x = jnp.asarray(x)
    X_mu = jnp.asarray(X_mu)
    X_log_sigma = jnp.asarray(X_log_sigma)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    plate_argument = unconstrained[0:2]
    def cell(ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau):
        return ppl_cell_b_person_subject_tau
    ppl_ljcells_b_person_subject_tau = (jnp.zeros(plate_argument.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in plate_argument.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(0,))(plate_argument))
    ppl_lkj_raw_b_person_subject_L = unconstrained[2:3]
    ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L = jnp.tanh(ppl_lkj_raw_b_person_subject_L)
    total = 0.0
    tuple_ = (1, 2)
    i = tuple_[0]
    j = tuple_[1]
    def loop_body(p, carry):
        (i_2, j_2, total_2) = carry
        total_3 = total_2 + (j_2 - i_2 + 1) / 2 * jnp.log(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            return (i_2 + 1, j_2)
        def else_arm():
            return (1, j_2 + 1)
        tuple__2 = jax.lax.cond(i_2 + 1 < j_2, then_arm, else_arm)
        i_3 = tuple__2[0]
        j_3 = tuple__2[1]
        return (i_3, j_3, total_3)
    loop_carry = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body, (jnp.asarray(i, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(total, dtype=jnp.float64)))
    let_value = loop_carry[2]
    ppl_lkj_logjac_b_person_subject_L = let_value
    plate_fold = jnp.sum(ppl_ljcells_b_person_subject_tau)
    log_jacobian_2 = plate_fold + ppl_lkj_logjac_b_person_subject_L
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop else else_arm())
    return log_jacobian_2

        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_2 + 1 < j_2, then_arm, else_arm)
        return (branch[1], branch[2], branch[3], branch[4])
    loop_carry = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body, (jnp.asarray(d, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j, dtype=jnp.int64), out))
    let_value = loop_carry[3]
    ppl_lkj_diagonal_b_person_subject_L = let_value
    out_2 = jnp.zeros((2, 2), dtype=jnp.float64)
    out_3 = out_2.at[0, 0].set(1.0)
    tuple__2 = (1, 2, 1.0)

    j_2 = tuple__2[1]

        out_5 = out_4.at[j_3 - 1, i_3 - 1].set(ppl_lkj_partials_b_person_subject_L[p_2 - 1] * w_2)

        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_3 + 1 < j_3, then_arm, else_arm)

    loop_carry_2 = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body_2, (jnp.asarray(i_2, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_2, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3, jnp.asarray(w, dtype=jnp.float64)))

def dimension(prepared: dict) -> int:
    """The length of `unconstrained` for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return int(prepared["ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop"])


def parameters(prepared: dict) -> dict:
    """Each parameter's 0-based `start`/`stop` in `unconstrained`, its transform and dimensions,
    for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return {"b_person_subject.tau": {"start": 0, "stop": 2, "transform": "exp", "dims": (2,)}, "b_person_subject.L": {"start": 2, "stop": 3, "transform": "lkj", "dims": (2, 2)}, "b_person_subject.z": {"start": 3, "stop": int(prepared["ppl_last_b_person_subject_z"]), "transform": "identity", "dims": (int(prepared["ppl_axis1_b_person_subject_z"]), 2)}, "pop_mu.beta_pop": {"start": int(prepared["ppl_first_pop_mu_beta_pop"]) - 1, "stop": int(prepared["ppl_last_pop_mu_beta_pop"]), "transform": "identity", "dims": (2,)}, "pop_log_sigma.beta_pop": {"start": int(prepared["ppl_first_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop"]) - 1, "stop": int(prepared["ppl_last_pop_log_sigma_beta_pop"]), "transform": "identity", "dims": (2,)}}

~ introduces a formula or a probability law; = computes a value. A formula allocates coefficients for its terms. Write 1 for an intercept: BRM does not insert one. The name sigma above holds the response-scale value exp(linear predictor). Its prior address is effect(sigma, ...); applying exp to sigma again would apply the link twice.

The BRM, intermediate-representation, StanBlocks and Stan panes all come from the same bound model. The following inspection checks the authored inputs and keeps the prior declarations visible.

julia
using BayesianRegressionModels
model = Main.BRMDocsComparisons.example_module(:SyntaxGuide).model
(inputs=data_columns(model), priors=string(priors_of(model)))

(inputs = [:x, :subject], priors = "effect(mu, 😃 ~ Normal(0, 1)\neffect(sigma, Intercept) ~ Normal(-1, 0.5)\neffect(sigma, x) ~ Normal(0, 0.2)\nsd(:, person) ~ Exponential(0.5)\ncor(:, person) ~ LKJCholesky(2, 2)")

Familiar formulaBRM meaning
1 + x + zAn intercept and two population effects
x * z / x & zMain effects plus interaction / interaction alone
(1 + x | subject)Correlated subject intercepts and slopes
(1 + x || subject)Independent subject intercepts and slopes
(1 | p | subject) in two predictorsOne correlation block spanning both predictors
(1 | gr(subject; by=arm))Separate group-effect distributions by stratum
Two response statementsA joint model; shared names share parameters
y ~ Normal(@brm(1 + x), exp(@brm(1)))Nested mean and log-scale formulas

Integer, string and categorical columns are factors; use floating-point values for a numeric trend. With an intercept, factors use treatment contrasts. Without one, the first eligible factor uses one coefficient per level. factor(g; cmc=false) keeps treatment coding; factor(g; ref=k) chooses a reference level. The reference gives the interaction and ordinal exceptions.

Nonlinear models and plates ​

Ordinary assignments combine sampled values without adding coefficients. This exponential-decay model has one rate per unit and several observations per unit. A groups binding connects the two axes.

brm-comparison
Two axes connected by a plate
panes: brm|stanblocks|rkppl|stan|jax:3
julia
decay = @brm begin
    log(rate) ~ 1 + (1 | unit)
    rows = groups(observation_unit => unit)
    @plate for i in eachindex(rate)
        mean_y = amplitude * exp.(-rate[i] .* time[rows[i]])
        y[rows[i]] ~ Normal(mean_y, noise)
    end

    amplitude ~ LogNormal(0, 0.5)
    noise ~ Exponential(0.2)
    effect(rate, Intercept) ~ Normal(-1, 0.5)
    sd(rate, unit) ~ Exponential(0.3)
end
model = decay((; unit=["a", "b"],
    observation_unit=["a", "b", "a", "b", "b"],
    time=[0., 0., 1., 1., 2.], y=[1.1, 0.9, 0.7, 0.6, 0.4]))

"""
Group-level (varying) effects of grouping `g`.

Non-centered, from the scale `tau[1]` (drawn from its prior) and standardized effects
`z[1:length(levels(g)), 1:1] ~ Normal(0, 1)`. Returns the
level-by-margin matrix `z .* tau[1]`, one row per level of `g` in order.
"""
brm_group_effects(g) = begin
        tau[1:1] .~ Exponential.(0.3)
        z[1:length(levels(g)), 1:1] .~ Normal.(0, 1)
        return z .* tau[1]
    end

begin
    unit_fit_levels = brm_fit_levels(unit_fit)
    b_rate__unit_unit ~ brm_group_effects(unit_fit_levels)
    unit_level = brm_level_indices(unit, unit_fit_levels)
    ranef_rate_rate__unit_unit = b_rate__unit_unit[unit_level, 1]
    rate_Intercept ~ Normal(-1.0, 0.5)

The loop follows the unit-level rate vector. Inside the cell, rate[i] is a unit's value, time[rows[i]] its observations, and bare amplitude is shared. Cell code uses Julia broadcasting explicitly. A bare left-hand name is local; an indexed left-hand name exposes a model output. Observe the response slice directly: an assignment that aliases it does not become a new observation.

For long-format series, @plate for p in groups(unit; order=time) iterates each unit's ordered row indices. An @scan within the cell states a recurrence; AR1Normal(mu[p], sigma, phi; time=time[p]) supplies an AR(1) residual law that accounts for gaps. Response families distinguishes residual dependence from a latent rw, dar or cdar term.

A function-style component gives each call its own parameters. Shared values are explicit arguments. This calibration is used twice with separate local intercepts and slopes.

"""
A calibration curve; every call owns its intercept and slope.
"""
left_component(x, shared_scale) = begin
        b ~ Normal(1.0, 0.2)
        a ~ Normal(0.0, shared_scale)
        value = a .+ b .* x
        component_result = value
        return component_result
    end

"""
A calibration curve; every call owns its intercept and slope.
"""
right_component(x, shared_scale) = begin
        b ~ Normal(1.0, 0.2)
        a ~ Normal(0.0, shared_scale)
        value = a .+ b .* x
        component_result = value
        return component_result
    end

begin
    shared_scale ~ Exponential(1.0)
    noise ~ Exponential(0.5)
    Core.@doc "A calibration curve; every call owns its intercept and slope." left ~ left_component(x_left, shared_scale)
    Core.@doc "A calibration curve; every call owns its intercept and slope." right ~ right_component(x_right, shared_scale)
    y_left .~ Normal.(left, noise)
    y_right .~ Normal.(right, noise)
end

functions {
vector normal_lpdfs(
    vector obs,
    vector loc,
    real scale
) {
    return jbroadcasted_normal_lpdfs(obs, loc, scale);
}
vector jbroadcasted_normal_lpdfs(
    vector x1,
    vector x2,
    real x3
) {
    int n = dims(x1)[1];
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = normal_lpdfs(broadcasted_getindex(x1, i), broadcasted_getindex(x2, i), x3);
    }
    return rv;
}
real normal_lpdfs(
    real args1,
    real args2,
    real args3
) {
    return normal_lpdf(args1 | args2, args3);
}
real broadcasted_getindex(vector x, int i) {
    return x[i];
}
vector normal_vector_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    vector a,
    real b
) {
    int n = anontok__1;
    if((n == 0)) {
        vector[n] rv;
        return rv;
    } else {
        return to_vector(normal_rng(a, b));
    }
}

        return -jnp.inf
    def else_arm():
        return -ppl_prior_shared_scale_log_scale - constrain / scale_binding
    logpdf = jax.lax.cond(constrain < 0, then_arm, else_arm)
    def then_arm_2():
        return -jnp.inf
    def else_arm_2():
        return -ppl_prior_noise_log_scale - constrain_2 / scale_binding_2
    logpdf_2 = jax.lax.cond(constrain_2 < 0, then_arm_2, else_arm_2)
    value = jnp.asarray(u_argument, dtype=jnp.float64)
    ppl_prior_left_a_log_scale = value
    def then_arm_3():
        return 1.0
    def else_arm_3():
        return constrain
    ppl_prior_left_a_standardized = (left_a - location_binding) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, left_a == location_binding), then_arm_3, else_arm_3)
    ppl_prior_left_a_standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * ppl_prior_left_a_standardized ** 2
    def then_arm_4():
        return 0.0
    def else_arm_4():
        return ppl_prior_left_a_log_scale
    logpdf_3 = ppl_prior_left_a_standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, left_a != location_binding), then_arm_4, else_arm_4)
    def then_arm_5():
        return 1.0
    def else_arm_5():
        return constrain
    ppl_prior_right_a_standardized = (right_a - location_binding_2) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, right_a == location_binding_2), then_arm_5, else_arm_5)
    ppl_prior_right_a_standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * ppl_prior_right_a_standardized ** 2
    def then_arm_6():
        return 0.0
    def else_arm_6():
        return ppl_prior_left_a_log_scale
    logpdf_4 = ppl_prior_right_a_standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, right_a != location_binding_2), then_arm_6, else_arm_6)
    prior = ppl_prior_parameters_normal + logpdf + logpdf_2 + logpdf_3 + logpdf_4
    u_argument_3 = unconstrained[0]
    u_argument_4 = unconstrained[1]
    log_jacobian = u_argument_3 + u_argument_4
    posterior = prior + likelihood + log_jacobian
    def then_arm_7():
        return None
    def else_arm_7():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value_2 = (then_arm_7() if unconstrained.size == 6 else else_arm_7())
    return posterior


def log_prior(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log prior density of the constrained parameters at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    x_left = prepared["x_left"]
    x_right = prepared["x_right"]
    y_left = prepared["y_left"]
    y_right = prepared["y_right"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    x_left = jnp.asarray(x_left)
    x_right = jnp.asarray(x_right)
    y_left = jnp.asarray(y_left)
    y_right = jnp.asarray(y_right)
    ppl_prior_parameters_normal_mu = jnp.asarray([1.0, 1.0], dtype=jnp.float64)
    ppl_prior_parameters_normal_sd = jnp.asarray([0.2, 0.2], dtype=jnp.float64)
    scale_binding = 1.0
    ppl_prior_shared_scale_log_scale = np.log(scale_binding)
    scale_binding_2 = 0.5
    ppl_prior_noise_log_scale = np.log(scale_binding_2)
    location_binding = 0.0
    location_binding_2 = 0.0
    u_argument = unconstrained[0]
    constrain = jnp.exp(u_argument)
    u_argument_2 = unconstrained[1]
    constrain_2 = jnp.exp(u_argument_2)
    left_b = unconstrained[2]
    left_a = unconstrained[3]
    right_b = unconstrained[4]
    right_a = unconstrained[5]
    plate_argument = (left_b, right_b)
    def cell(value, location, scale):
        log_scale = jnp.log(scale)
        def then_arm():
            return 1.0
        def else_arm():
            return scale
        standardized = (value - location) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(scale == 0, value == location), then_arm, else_arm)
        standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
        def then_arm_2():
            return 0.0
        def else_arm_2():
            return log_scale
        logpdf = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(scale == 0, value != location), then_arm_2, else_arm_2)
        return logpdf
    ppl_prior_parameters_normal_pw = (jnp.zeros(jnp.stack(plate_argument).shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in jnp.stack(plate_argument).shape[:1] and ppl_prior_parameters_normal_mu.shape[:1] == jnp.stack(plate_argument).shape[:1] and ppl_prior_parameters_normal_sd.shape[:1] == jnp.stack(plate_argument).shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(0, 0, 0))(jnp.stack(plate_argument), ppl_prior_parameters_normal_mu, ppl_prior_parameters_normal_sd))
    ppl_prior_parameters_normal = jnp.sum(ppl_prior_parameters_normal_pw)
    def then_arm():
        return -jnp.inf
    def else_arm():
        return -ppl_prior_shared_scale_log_scale - constrain / scale_binding
    logpdf = jax.lax.cond(constrain < 0, then_arm, else_arm)
    def then_arm_2():
        return -jnp.inf
    def else_arm_2():
        return -ppl_prior_noise_log_scale - constrain_2 / scale_binding_2
    logpdf_2 = jax.lax.cond(constrain_2 < 0, then_arm_2, else_arm_2)
    value = jnp.asarray(u_argument, dtype=jnp.float64)
    ppl_prior_left_a_log_scale = value
    def then_arm_3():
        return 1.0
    def else_arm_3():
        return constrain
    ppl_prior_left_a_standardized = (left_a - location_binding) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, left_a == location_binding), then_arm_3, else_arm_3)
    ppl_prior_left_a_standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * ppl_prior_left_a_standardized ** 2
    def then_arm_4():
        return 0.0
    def else_arm_4():
        return ppl_prior_left_a_log_scale
    logpdf_3 = ppl_prior_left_a_standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, left_a != location_binding), then_arm_4, else_arm_4)
    def then_arm_5():
        return 1.0
    def else_arm_5():
        return constrain
    ppl_prior_right_a_standardized = (right_a - location_binding_2) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, right_a == location_binding_2), then_arm_5, else_arm_5)
    ppl_prior_right_a_standard_logpdf = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * ppl_prior_right_a_standardized ** 2
    def then_arm_6():
        return 0.0
    def else_arm_6():
        return ppl_prior_left_a_log_scale
    logpdf_4 = ppl_prior_right_a_standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(constrain == 0, right_a != location_binding_2), then_arm_6, else_arm_6)
    prior = ppl_prior_parameters_normal + logpdf + logpdf_2 + logpdf_3 + logpdf_4
    def then_arm_7():
        return None
    def else_arm_7():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value_2 = (then_arm_7() if unconstrained.size == 6 else else_arm_7())
    return prior


def log_likelihood(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log likelihood of the observations at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    x_left = prepared["x_left"]
    x_right = prepared["x_right"]
    y_left = prepared["y_left"]
    y_right = prepared["y_right"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    x_left = jnp.asarray(x_left)
    x_right = jnp.asarray(x_right)
    y_left = jnp.asarray(y_left)
    y_right = jnp.asarray(y_right)
    u_argument = unconstrained[1]
    constrain = jnp.exp(u_argument)
    left_b = unconstrained[2]
    left_a = unconstrained[3]
    right_b = unconstrained[4]
    right_a = unconstrained[5]
    def cell(left_a_2, left_b_2, x_left_2):
        plate_value = left_a_2 + left_b_2 * x_left_2
        return plate_value
    left_value = (jnp.zeros(x_left.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in x_left.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(None, None, 0))(left_a, left_b, x_left))
    def cell_2(right_a_2, right_b_2, x_right_2):
        plate_value = right_a_2 + right_b_2 * x_right_2
        return plate_value
    right_value = (jnp.zeros(x_right.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in x_right.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_2, in_axes=(None, None, 0))(right_a, right_b, x_right))
    def cell_3(y_left_2, left, noise):
        def then_arm():
            log_scale = jnp.log(noise)
            def then_arm_2():
                return 1.0
            def else_arm():
                return noise
            value = (y_left_2 - left) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(noise == 0, y_left_2 == left), then_arm_2, else_arm)
            standardized = value
            value_2 = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            standard_logpdf = value_2
            def then_arm_3():
                return 0.0
            def else_arm_2():
                return log_scale
            value_3 = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(noise == 0, y_left_2 != left), then_arm_3, else_arm_2)
            return value_3
        def else_arm_3():
            return -jnp.inf
        ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(noise > 0, then_arm, else_arm_3)
        return ppl_density
    ppl_pw_y_left_resp = (jnp.zeros(y_left.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in y_left.shape[:1] and left_value.shape[:1] == y_left.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_3, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(y_left, left_value, constrain))
    ppl_lik_y_left_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_y_left_resp)
    def cell_4(y_right_2, right, noise):
        def then_arm():
            log_scale = jnp.log(noise)
            def then_arm_2():
                return 1.0
            def else_arm():
                return noise
            value = (y_right_2 - right) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(noise == 0, y_right_2 == right), then_arm_2, else_arm)
            standardized = value
            value_2 = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            standard_logpdf = value_2
            def then_arm_3():
                return 0.0
            def else_arm_2():
                return log_scale
            value_3 = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(noise == 0, y_right_2 != right), then_arm_3, else_arm_2)
            return value_3
        def else_arm_3():
            return -jnp.inf
        ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(noise > 0, then_arm, else_arm_3)
        return ppl_density
    ppl_pw_y_right_resp = (jnp.zeros(y_right.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in y_right.shape[:1] and right_value.shape[:1] == y_right.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_4, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(y_right, right_value, constrain))
    ppl_lik_y_right_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_y_right_resp)
    likelihood = ppl_lik_y_left_resp + ppl_lik_y_right_resp
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == 6 else else_arm())
    return likelihood


def log_jacobian(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log Jacobian of the constraining transforms at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    x_left = prepared["x_left"]
    x_right = prepared["x_right"]
    y_left = prepared["y_left"]
    y_right = prepared["y_right"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    x_left = jnp.asarray(x_left)
    x_right = jnp.asarray(x_right)
    y_left = jnp.asarray(y_left)
    y_right = jnp.asarray(y_right)
    u_argument = unconstrained[0]
    u_argument_2 = unconstrained[1]
    log_jacobian_2 = u_argument + u_argument_2
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == 6 else else_arm())
    return log_jacobian_2


def constrain(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The constrained value of each parameter, and of each requested value, at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`. Returns a dict, a submodel's values nested under its name:

    - `shared_scale`
    - `noise`
    - `left.b`
    - `left.a`
    - `right.b`
    - `right.a`
    """
    x_left = prepared["x_left"]
    x_right = prepared["x_right"]
    y_left = prepared["y_left"]
    y_right = prepared["y_right"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    x_left = jnp.asarray(x_left)
    x_right = jnp.asarray(x_right)
    y_left = jnp.asarray(y_left)
    y_right = jnp.asarray(y_right)
    u_argument = unconstrained[0]
    constrain_2 = jnp.exp(u_argument)
    u_argument_2 = unconstrained[1]
    constrain_3 = jnp.exp(u_argument_2)
    left_b = unconstrained[2]
    left_a = unconstrained[3]
    right_b = unconstrained[4]
    right_a = unconstrained[5]
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == 6 else else_arm())
    return {"shared_scale": constrain_2, "noise": constrain_3, "left": {"b": left_b, "a": left_a}, "right": {"b": right_b, "a": right_a}}


def dimension(prepared: dict) -> int:
    """The length of `unconstrained` for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return 6


def parameters(prepared: dict) -> dict:
    """Each parameter's 0-based `start`/`stop` in `unconstrained`, its transform and dimensions,
    for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return {"shared_scale": {"start": 0, "stop": 1, "transform": "exp", "dims": ()}, "noise": {"start": 1, "stop": 2, "transform": "exp", "dims": ()}, "left.b": {"start": 2, "stop": 3, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "left.a": {"start": 3, "stop": 4, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "right.b": {"start": 4, "stop": 5, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "right.a": {"start": 5, "stop": 6, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}}

using BayesianRegressionModels
model = Main.BRMDocsComparisons.example_module(:ComponentGuide).model
calls = brm_components(model)
@assert length(calls) == 2
[call.path for call in calls]

(:left,)(:right,)

Components accept positional and keyword inputs, including defaults, and resolve functions in their defining module. A named return such as return (; recovery, decay) exposes kin.recovery and kin.decay after kin ~ kinetics(...). Before indexing a returned field in a plate, bind it at model scope, recovery = kin.recovery, then read recovery[i]. brm_components discovers the definitions and call paths; descriptor queries use submodel=:left rather than generated names.

Use merge(structure_a, structure_b, priors_a, priors_b) for fragments that share one namespace. Put structure first and priors last within each scope; moving a cell-local prior outside the plate changes the model. A retained builder can bind new data; reprocess(backend, new_data) instead preserves the fit's preprocessing. These are different operations.

The Warfarin example combines group predictors, nonlinear time courses and observations on several axes.
